Introduction

Kaede is a Japanese dancer and singer under MODHAUS.

Kaede was introduced as the ninth member of the girl group tripleS on November 9, 2022. She made her debut with the first ten members of the group on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE".

As a member of tripleS, Kaede was placed in the sub-units LOVElution, Aria, Visionary Vision and Moon.
